title: 9 Questions a Godly Man Asks Before He Moves to a New City
caption:
A new city can be the best thing that ever happened to your walk with God, or the place you quietly drift for three years without anyone noticing.

Before you sign the lease: find the church, pick your men, check your motives, and ask someone who might tell you no. Then go as a giver.

Send this to the brother who's about to move.
